result.instructions: Tools for Papierkram, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices are still unpaid, and for how much?"; "Show my expense vouchers from last quarter for supplier Hetzner."; "How many hours did I track on project Website Relaunch this month and are they billed?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Papierkram data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run papierkram_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run papierkram_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run papierkram_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. papierkram_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: papierkram_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT outgoing invoice (state draft; it is NOT finalized or sent, and gets no invoice number until the user completes it in Papierkram). Needs a payment term id (papierkram_list_payment_terms) and at least one line item. Use papierkram_list_invoices afterwards to check it. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

contact_person_id.description: Contact person of the customer (from papierkram_list_persons).

gross.description: False (default): prices are net. True: prices are gross.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.19 for 19%, 0.07 for 7%, 0 for none.

price.description: Net unit price (or gross when gross is true: see price_gross).

discount_percentage.description: Discount as a fraction, e.g. 0.1 for 10%.

tools.name: papierkram_get_voucher_pdf
tools.description: Get the PDF that Papierkram makes for one expense voucher (GET /expense/vouchers/{id}/pdf). The API reference does not say whether it embeds the uploaded receipt; for the original uploaded file use papierkram_get_voucher_document. Returns the PDF as an embedded file (up to 3 MB).

tools.name: papierkram_get_voucher_document
tools.description: Get an original file uploaded to an expense voucher (a receipt PDF or image), so its content can be read. Reads the voucher (papierkram_get_voucher) and fetches documents[].uri. Images come back as images, PDFs as an embedded file (up to 3 MB). The API has no documented download for one document: if Papierkram does not serve the file to an API token, the tool says so; then use papierkram_get_voucher_pdf. Files that are not yet attached to a voucher (the upload inbox) are not reachable through the Papierkram API.

document_id.description: Document id (documents[].id of papierkram_get_voucher). Needed only when the voucher has more than one document.

tools.name: papierkram_upload_voucher_document
tools.description: WRITE: attach a file (receipt PDF or image) to an existing expense voucher (POST /expense/vouchers/{id}/documents). The file is given as base64, up to 3 MB. Check papierkram_get_voucher first: a repeated upload attaches the file twice. Costs 10 Papierkram API credits.

content_base64.description: The file content as standard base64.

tools.name: papierkram_create_voucher
tools.description: WRITE: book an expense voucher (Beleg) in Papierkram, e.g. from a receipt. Papierkram books it at once (state unpaid, no draft), so this tool works in two steps. Without confirm it creates nothing: it returns the exact request and possible duplicates (same document date, creditor and total) for the user to review. After the user approves, call again with the same arguments and confirm: true. Then attach the file with papierkram_upload_voucher_document and record a payment with papierkram_pay_voucher. Asset categories that need a depreciation (AfA) setting must be finished in Papierkram. Costs 50 Papierkram API credits; each duplicate check reads 1.

name.description: Voucher title, e.g. the supplier and the receipt number.

provenance.description: Where the supplier is: domestic (Germany), eu or foreign.

creditor_id.description: Supplier company id (from papierkram_list_companies; it must be a supplier).

flagged.description: Mark the voucher for a later check.

entertainment_reason.description: Reason of a business meal (Bewirtungskosten only).

entertainment_persons.description: Guests of a business meal (Bewirtungskosten only).

amount.description: Amount of the line. The API reference does not say gross or net: check the preview and the first created voucher in Papierkram.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.19, 0.07 or 0.

category.description: Papierkram expense category (Kategorie), e.g. Bürobedarf, Bewirtungskosten, Telefon.

tools.name: papierkram_pay_voucher
tools.description: WRITE: book a payment of an expense voucher (POST /expense/vouchers/{id}/pay), with a value and payment date or with an existing bank transaction. Without confirm it changes nothing: it reads the voucher and returns the exact request for the user to review. After approval, call again with confirm: true. A value that differs from the open amount needs difference_reason (teilzahlung = part payment, skonto = cash discount, mahnung = reminder fee, schmaelerung = reduction, sonstige = other). A repeated call books a second payment: after an error, check the voucher state with papierkram_get_voucher before retrying.

value.description: Paid amount. Needed unless banking_transaction_id is given.

payment_date.description: Payment date yyyy-mm-dd (default: Papierkram's default, today).

banking_transaction_id.description: Bank transaction that paid the voucher (from papierkram_list_bank_transactions).

difference_reason.description: Why the value differs from the open amount.

confirm.description: False or missing: preview only, nothing is booked. True: book the payment now.

tools.name: papierkram_update_voucher
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing expense voucher (PUT /expense/vouchers/{id}): title, supplier, provenance, dates, notes, flag or line items (amount, VAT rate, category). Only the fields you pass are changed. line_items REPLACES all lines of the voucher: pass the full new list. Without confirm it changes nothing: it reads the voucher and returns its current values next to the exact request for the user to review. After approval, call again with the same arguments and confirm: true. Papierkram refuses a voucher that can no longer be edited (e.g. a paid or locked one). Lines with a billing (re-invoicing) or depreciation (AfA) setting cannot be replaced here, so the tool refuses line_items for such a voucher; change those lines in Papierkram. Payments are booked with papierkram_pay_voucher. Costs 1 Papierkram API credit; the preview, and a confirmed line change, also read the voucher (1 each).

due_date.description: New due date yyyy-mm-dd; null removes the due date.

creditor_id.description: New supplier company id (from papierkram_list_companies; it must be a supplier).

flagged.description: Mark (true) or unmark (false) the voucher for a later check.

entertainment_reason.description: Reason of a business meal (Bewirtungskosten only).

entertainment_persons.description: Guests of a business meal (Bewirtungskosten only).

line_items.description: The complete new list of voucher lines. It replaces ALL current lines.

amount.description: Amount of the line. The API reference does not say gross or net: check the preview and the first created voucher in Papierkram.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.19, 0.07 or 0.
